name: Healthchecks
description: Healthchecks is a cron job monitoring service. It listens for HTTP requests and email messages from your cron jobs and scheduled tasks.
composeYaml:
services:
  healthchecks:
    image: 'healthchecks/healthchecks:v4.2'
    container_name: healthchecks
    environment:
      - DB=sqlite
      - DB_NAME=/data/hc.sqlite
      - 'ALLOWED_HOSTS=${ALLOWED_HOSTS:-*}'
      - 'REGISTRATION_OPEN=${REGISTRATION_OPEN:-True}'
      - 'DEBUG=${DEBUG:-False}'
      - 'SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_KEY:?${HEALTHCHECKS_PASSWORD}}'
      - 'SITE_ROOT=${APP_URL}'
      - 'DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL=${DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL:-fixme-email-address-here}'
      - 'EMAIL_HOST=${EMAIL_HOST:-my-smtp-server-here.com}'
      - 'EMAIL_PORT=${EMAIL_PORT:-465}'
      - 'EMAIL_HOST_USER=${EMAIL_HOST_USER:-my_username}'
      - 'EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD=${EMAIL_HOST_PASSWORD:-mypassword}'
      - 'EMAIL_USE_SSL=${EMAIL_USE_SSL:-True}'
      - 'EMAIL_USE_TLS=${EMAIL_USE_TLS:-False}'
    volumes:
      - 'healthchecks-data:/data'

meta.about: Listen for pings and sends alerts when pings are late.
